backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for a multi-author blog platform on ICP, managing posts, user profiles, image storage, and role-based access control (owner/admin/user) with CRUD operations for posts and admin management functions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping three implemented features (multi-author post creation, shareable post links, and unauthenticated preview/login gate) to their relevant source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON document containing one-to-two sentence summaries of each frontend source file, describing the purpose and key implementation details of each component, page, hook, and utility.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for the design system's color tokens in both light and dark modes, plus base body and border styles.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell with Swedish language attribute, HKLO as the page title, and a root div that mounts the React application via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: TanStack Router setup defining all application routes; the post detail route (/post/$id) is publicly accessible without ProtectedRoute, while home, create, edit, and admin routes require authentication.
frontend/src/components/admin/AllPostsSe: Admin table view of all posts with controls to edit, delete, and change the publish status of each post.
frontend/src/components/admin/ManageAdmi: Admin panel section for listing, adding, and removing admin principals via Internet Identity principal IDs.
frontend/src/components/admin/ManageAuth: Admin panel section that lists all authors and allows removing an author along with all their posts.
frontend/src/components/admin/PostEditMo: Modal dialog for admins to edit an existing post's title, content, author, status, and images, including adding or removing images.
frontend/src/components/ImageGallery.tsx: React component that converts Uint8Array image data to blob URLs (with ref-based cleanup on unmount) and renders them in a responsive grid, showing placeholders for missing or broken images.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Application shell component with a sticky header, footer, and navigation that shows full nav links (Hem, Skapa inlägg, Admin, Logga ut) to authenticated users and a Logga in button to unauthenticated visitors.
frontend/src/components/PostCard.tsx: Renders a blog post card with thumbnail image, title, author, date, content preview, and a share button that copies the post link to clipboard.
frontend/src/components/ProtectedRoute.t: Wraps routes to require Internet Identity authentication, redirecting unauthenticated or anonymous users to the login page.
frontend/src/config/constants.ts: Exports a single constant holding the hardcoded admin principal ID string.
frontend/src/data/titleSuggestions.ts: Defines blog post title suggestions organized by category (Livsstil, Mat, Hobby, etc.) and exports the category list.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, returning either an authenticated or anonymous actor based on the current Internet Identity, and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useImageUpload.ts: React hook that manages image file selection, validation, compression (via Canvas API to JPEG), and preview URL generation, exposing state and helpers for adding/removing images.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend interactions including fetching/creating/updating/deleting posts, checking admin status, and managing admins and authors.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines a warm editorial CSS custom property palette for both light and dark modes, plus base typography styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page that checks caller admin status and renders tabbed sections for managing posts, admins, and authors, with loading and access-denied states.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePostPage.tsx: Page component with a form for creating a new blog post, supporting title, content, author, publish toggle, category/title suggestions, and image uploads with validation.
frontend/src/pages/EditPostPage.tsx: Page component for editing an existing blog post, including form fields for title, content, author, category, publish status, and image management. Validates ownership via Internet Identity before allowing edits.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home page that fetches and displays all published posts sorted by creation date using PostCard components, with loading and error states.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page that authenticates users via Internet Identity, redirecting already-authenticated users to home and providing a link to create a new Internet Identity.
frontend/src/pages/PostDetailPage.tsx: Detail page for a single blog post showing full content, images, and owner-only edit/delete controls, with a login gate for unauthenticated users.
frontend/src/utils/contentTruncator.ts: Utility function that truncates blog post content to a maximum word count while preserving sentence boundaries.
frontend/src/utils/dateFormatter.ts: Utility function that converts a nanosecond-precision IC timestamp to a Swedish locale date string.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, extended typography/serif fonts, border radius variables, and animation keyframes for accordion and collapsible components.
project_state.json: Tracks the HKLO Blog project state including existing features (multi-author posts, shareable links, unauthenticated preview/login gate) and pending requests for anonymous actor access to post data. Version 3 of the project state schema.
